acquisition method: The survey scans (380 to 2,000 m/z, target value 3E6 charges, maximum ion injection time 50 ms) were acquired and followed by higher-energy collisional dissociation–based fragmentation (normalized collision energy 25). A resolution of 70,000 was used for survey scans, and up to 15 dynamically chosen most abundant precursor ions, with “peptide preferable” profile, were fragmented (isolation window 1.6 m/z).
cleavage agent: Trypsin was added (0.3 μg per sample)
collision energy: higher-energy collisional dissociation–based fragmentation (normalized collision energy 25)
enrichment method: To identify mitochondrial MiNT-interacting protein partners, we used a coimmunoprecipitation (Co-IP) approach
fragmentation method: followed by higher-energy collisional dissociation–based fragmentation (normalized collision energy 25)
instrument: MS analysis was performed using a Q Exactive Plus mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific)
labeling: Relative protein quantification in MaxQuant was performed using the label-free quantification algorithm.
reduction reagent: Packed beads were then resuspended in 100 μL of 8M urea, 10 mM dithiothreitol (DTT), 25 mM Tris⋅HCl pH 8.0 and incubated for 30 min at 22 °C.
